team.title: This is us!
team.description: A group full of Minecraft, Star Wars, and film fans. Talented experts are at your side in all areas. Get to know us during relaxed game nights and create something great with us!
team.flame-important-position: Positions marked with flames are currently in high demand!

form.name: What's your name?
form.joined_discord: I have already joined the BALTIC GALAXY Discord server.

form.about_label_description: A little guidance: Who are you? Where are you in life? What's cool about you? What skills and maybe experience do you bring?
form.werke: Would you like to show us your work? Then add the links to the respective websites here.
form.accept_privacy: I understand that after clicking the following button, I will no longer be able to edit the application. I also acknowledge that the team members of BALTIC STUDIOS have access to my application.

questions.question1: Do I need extensive knowledge about Star Wars?
questions.answer1: No, you don't need to be a Star Wars expert to join our team. We are happy to explain everything you need to know. However, as a content creator, you should be able to dive deeper into Star Wars.
questions.question2: Can I hold multiple positions in the team?
questions.answer2: We want you to be able to fully focus on your area. Therefore, it is not possible to take on multiple tasks at first. After consultation, however, you can support one or the other area.
questions.question3: How much time do I need to have?
questions.answer3: We know what it's like to sometimes have less motivation or time for something. Therefore, we do not set any minimum performance requirements. We openly discuss your wishes with you so that you feel comfortable!
questions.answer4: Since everything is privately financed, we are unable to pay you. We are all in this because it is our passion.
questions.question5: Will I receive feedback after a rejected application?
questions.answer5: We handle our decisions transparently. If it didn't work out between us, we will let you know why. This way, you get the chance to improve!

application.title: STATUS OF YOUR APPLICATION
application.description: We are delighted that you want to be part of BALTIC STUDIOS. Please be patient, we will contact you as soon as possible!
application.onboarding_description: We want you to feel at home with us. Therefore, from day one, we will guide you and explain our team structure and what great things we have planned with you! We make sure to go at your pace. Over time, you will get to know the whole team well.
